description: Minimal capability surface for the main window (audit #2). Filesystem access is via custom, path-guarded Tauri commands (src-tauri/src/path_guard.rs) — the fs plugin is NOT enabled, so there is no unscoped fs surface to grant. The opener plugin is used only server-side via the Rust OpenerExt (crash report/logs open, both repo/app-scoped in Rust); the webview is intentionally NOT granted opener IPC. Keep this set minimal — capabilityScope.test.mjs enforces it.
